summary: Post-offer bridge account reconciliation, temporary service-account handoff, and loaner hardware return for Research Ops new hire
description:
Issue summary: New Research Ops hire (Ana Silva) started with a temporary 'bridge' service-account and loaner MacBook Pro pending final workstation delivery. HR completed offer on 2026-03-05 and requested a reconciled set of permanent accounts, removal of the bridge account, transfer of any delegated AWS service roles, and return/verification of loaner hardware to inventory.

Impact: Until bridge account is reconciled and delegated roles transferred, Ana cannot access a subset of AWS test buckets and a private Slack channel used by the research infra team. Loaner hardware needs to be checked for company data wipe and asset tag reassignment. Policy question: can we re-use the bridge service-account as a team-owned automation account or must it be destroyed per policy?

Desired outcome: 1) Transfer any active IAM delegations from bridge account to new SSO-linked user or team service-account; 2) Confirm bridge account removal and document who requested retention if any; 3) Receive loaner MBP back into IT inventory with secure wipe; 4) HR and Research Ops have a short runbook documenting the handoff and policy rationale.
steps_taken: 1) HR created new SSO user (ana.silva@redwood.ai) on 2026-03-05. 2) IT provisioned loaner MBP asset tag IT-LOAN-783. 3) On 2026-03-06 Support added Ana to research-ops Slack and granted temporary access by creating 'bridge-research-2026' service-account and adding it to an IAM role with limited S3 access. 4) Automated inventory shows loaner checkout active. 5) Ana confirmed primary workstation delivery ETA 2026-03-18. 6) Request filed to reconcile delegations and schedule asset return pickup.
comments: 2026-03-08 - Elena Garcia (Reporter): Opening ticket after HR flagged gap between temporary account and permanent SSO user. Linked to HR offer EMR #3321. Requesting guidance on policy for reuse of temp service accounts.

2026-03-09 - Ravi Patel (Assignee): Investigating current IAM bindings. Observed bridge-research-2026 has two active IAM role attachments (s3:research-buckets-read, sts:assume-role into research-test-runner). Need approver from Research Ops to approve transfer or rotation of keys before decommissioning.

2026-03-10 - Priya Narang (Research Ops): Confirm Research lead (Marcus Lee) approves transfer of the sts:assume-role binding to team-service-ops account. Marcus asked that the s3 read policy remain as-is for now. Marcus also requests a short delay on deleting the bridge account until ongoing test runs complete (by 2026-03-16).
2026-03-11 - IT Inventory (Automated): Loaner MBP IT-LOAN-783 flagged for pickup. Suggested pickup window 2026-03-13 to 2026-03-15. Note: device shows last check-in 2026-03-09; FileVault enabled.

2026-03-12 - Ravi Patel: Confirmed there are no GitHub tokens associated with bridge-research-2026. Proposed action: 1) Rotate any long-lived creds, 2) Move sts:assume-role binding to team-service-ops with audit log entry, 3) Schedule deletion on 2026-03-20 unless Research Ops objects. Planning asset pickup 2026-03-14. Need formal approval from Marcus for transfer and deletion timetable.

2026-03-12 - Marcus Lee (Research Lead): Approve transfer to team-service-ops. Ok to delay deletion until 2026-03-20 to complete current jobs. Please confirm inventory wipe checklist is followed on loaner return.
investigation_notes:
- IAM: bridge-research-2026 has no console MFA set and two active role attachments. No evidence of external sharing.
- AWS CloudTrail indicates last assume-role events from the bridge account on 2026-03-07 during scheduled test run.
- Inventory shows loaner device has company profiles and a Chrome profile containing cached tokens; FileVault is enabled but Chrome profile requires secure wipe.
- No linked GitHub deploy keys found.
Hypothesis: The bridge account was intentionally left active to prevent test runs from failing; safe transfer requires rotating STS trust and ensuring job runners use team-service-ops credentials.
Open questions: 1) Policy: Are bridge accounts allowed to persist as team-owned automation accounts with a documented owner? 2) Should IT automatically reassign asset tag to new workstation record once loaner returned or hold asset for re-imaging?
resolution: Pending. Planned actions: 1) On 2026-03-14 at 10:00 UTC, IT will pick up loaner MBP IT-LOAN-783 and perform secure wipe following Asset Wipe Checklist (confluence page linked). 2) On 2026-03-14 at 16:00 UTC, Ravi will create team-service-ops role policy update and rotate STS trust; record change in audit log and Slack #infra-ops. 3) Bridge account scheduled for deletion 2026-03-20 unless Research Ops raises a blocking issue by 2026-03-18. 4) HR to update onboarding checklist to include bridge-account reconciliation task. Follow-up: create a short runbook for this workflow and propose a policy clarification in Security Guild. Will update ticket when transfer, wipe, and deletion are complete.
